title: Clean Data Can Still Carry Backdoors: Support-Persistent Backdoors for Model Reuse
abstract: arXiv:2610.21208v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Traditional backdoor attacks inject artificial trigger patterns into training data, causing models to misclassify triggered inputs while maintaining normal behavior on clean samples. Since these artificial triggers are absent in clean datasets, standard knowledge distillation (KD) typically eliminates them, leading to the common belief that KD serves as an effective purification defense. In this paper, we propose DAR (Discover-and-Relabel), a support-persistent backdoor method that retains its behavior even after clean-data distillation. DAR identifies naturally abundant patterns in low-dimensional feature subspaces using subspace clustering and applies label-only poisoning to samples that inherently satisfy the discovered rule. At test time, the backdoor is activated by locally modifying the corresponding subspace of the target images. translated_title: 干净数据仍可能携带后门：面向模型复用的支持持久化后门
translated_abstract: 传统的后门攻击会在训练数据中注入人工触发模式，导致模型对被触发的输入产生错误分类，同时对干净样本保持正常行为。由于这些人工触发模式并不存在于干净数据集中，标准的知识蒸馏（KD）通常会将它们消除，因此人们普遍认为知识蒸馏是一种有效的净化防御手段。在本文中，我们提出了DAR（Discover-and-Relabel，发现与重标注），一种支持持久化的后门方法，即使经过干净数据蒸馏后仍能保留其攻击行为。DAR利用子空间聚类识别低维特征子空间中天然存在的丰富模式，并对天然满足所发现规则的样本仅进行标签投毒。在测试阶段，通过局部修改目标图像的相应子空间来激活后门。通过实例化空间算子和频率算子，DAR实现了与最先进方法相当的攻击准确率。
tldr: 本文提出DAR后门攻击方法，通过挖掘数据中天然存在的低维子空间模式并进行标签投毒，使后门在干净数据知识蒸馏后依然存留，打破了“知识蒸馏可有效净化后门”的普遍认知。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DAR, a support-persistent backdoor that exploits naturally occurring subspace patterns with label-only poisoning, enabling the backdoor to survive clean-data knowledge distillation and challenging the belief that KD serves as an effective purification defense.
